summary: Iteration 3 backend-only verification of the Hybrid AI Mode router. All 19 unit tests in test_ai_mode.py pass. Created /app/backend/tests/test_admin_ai_mode_http.py with 8 HTTP smoke tests against the preview URL — all 8 pass (GET default, PUT→hybrid, GET persistence, PUT invalid→400, PUT/GET no-auth→401/403, non-admin GET+PUT→403, reset to claude_only). Backwards-compat regression: 26 surgical_fixes + 24 surgical_fixes_v2 + 19 ai_mode = 69/69 still pass; with the new HTTP suite total is 77/77. Source-string introspection confirms stream_agent_turn (lines 8873-8907) calls get_ai_mode + classify_phase + pick_provider, and that GPT_PROVIDER='openai_direct' is appended to the provider list ONLY when (_prov == GPT_PROVIDER AND OPENAI_DIRECT_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY is set). _stream_one_provider at line 9071 handles the 'openai_direct' branch.

minor.issue: Body validation accepts a raw dict (no Pydantic model) — extra/unknown keys are silently ignored. Functional for the current contract but a typed AdminAIModeUpdate(BaseModel) would give clearer 422 errors and OpenAPI schema. Non-blocking.

On import failure inside the AI-router try/except, GPT_PROVIDER is assigned in the except block ONLY for that branch — the variable is later referenced unconditionally at line 8898. If the import succeeds, GPT_PROVIDER is correctly imported. If it fails, the local fallback `GPT_PROVIDER = 'openai_direct'` is set. Logic is correct but slightly fragile; consider moving the constant to a module-level fallback. Non-blocking.
